function t1.value148(p82, p83)

    raycastParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude

    local raycastResult = workspace:Raycast(CFramePosition, v287, raycastParams)

    if raycastResult then
        raycastResult = raycastResult.Instance:IsDescendantOf(p82.Parent)
    end

    return raycastResult
end
function t1.value149()
    local n3 = 1e999
    local v313
    local v314 = t1.value7.ViewportSize / 2
    if not t1.value8.Character or not t1.value8.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
        return nil
    end
    local HumanoidRootPartPosition = t1.value8.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position
    for _, player in ipairs(t1.value3:GetPlayers()) do
        if not (player ~= t1.value8 and player.Character) then
            continue
        end

        local Humanoid = player.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")

        if not Humanoid or Humanoid.Health <= 0 or t1.value21 and player.Team == t1.value8.Team then
            continue
        end

        if t1.value24 then
            local v319 = player.Team and player.Team.Name

            if v319 and t1.value25[v319] == false then
                continue
            end
        end

        local HumanoidRootPart = player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

        if HumanoidRootPart then
            local Magnitude = (HumanoidRootPart.Position - HumanoidRootPartPosition).Magnitude

            if not (Magnitude > t1.value27) then
                local t1value20 = player.Character:FindFirstChild(t1.value20)

                if t1value20 then
                    if t1.value26 == "Distance" then
                        if Magnitude < n3 and t1.value148(t1value20, t1.value22) then
                            n3 = Magnitude
                            v313 = t1value20
                        end
                    else
                        local v324, t9Result = t1.value7:WorldToViewportPoint(t1value20.Position)
                        if t9Result then
                            local Magnitude2 = (Vector2.new(v324.X, v324.Y) - v314).Magnitude

                            if Magnitude2 < n3 and (Magnitude2 < t1.value14 and t1.value148(t1value20, t1.value22)) then
                                v313 = t1value20
                                n3 = Magnitude2
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    return v313
end
